name: Scorching Desert, Outside Village
desc1: White sand dunes sprawl off in all directions here, making navigation
desc2: confusing as there are no clear paths or identifiable markers. The
desc3: heat here is intense, and when combined with the occasional harsh
desc4: bursts of wind, parches the throat and sears the skin. To the west,
desc5: a large village stands, partially shielded by the wrath of the desert
desc6: by the rocky walls of the mountainside.
